scope: Complete implemented time observation family: gettimeofday, clock_gettime and clock_getres; source/solo ABI, source seccomp admission, guest output fault/null/overlap ordering and actual native vDSO realtime entry.

architecture.execution: Short time observations execute on the original calling worker. The standalone dispatch uses the same Linux ABI bodies; no joined syscall is required for gettimeofday, including its vDSO SVC.
architecture.clocks: Realtime remains live host SystemTime. Session monotonic/raw/coarse epochs and boottime are unchanged. Immutable hardware-counter calibration is used only by the existing monotonic vDSO fast path; no stale extrapolated realtime page or recurring clock service is introduced.
architecture.memory: The original Linux address limit and two-buffer preflight are retained for gettimeofday. Its seconds/microseconds/timezone write order, overlapping outputs, null destinations and existing errors are unchanged. Clock IDs retain their low-32-bit ABI and original preflight/null-resolution behavior.

validation_notes: The new interpreter regression fails against prior production code at its first gettimeofday, before the completion marker. Final four/twelve-CPU, one-slot and allowed-seccomp cases retain one cohort with zero returned syscall, service or mm checkpoint.

The native fixture resolves the actual __kernel_gettimeofday ELF export and also exercises raw realtime/clock syscalls and a faulting timezone output for every thread. Old four-CPU execution exits successfully but requires ten cohorts and sixteen returned gettimeofday calls; final four/twelve-CPU execution has one cohort and zero returned syscalls. No throughput speedup or twelve-CPU before measurement is claimed.
Initial sandboxed runtime tests could not create existing TCP/UDP sockets (EPERM). The unchanged tests pass outside that socket restriction.

One complete process run and bounded repetitions exposed the old mqueue fixture budget assumption: at twelve CPUs an untouched actor remained at PC 0x4000 with only seventeen total syscalls, rather than having returned an empty directory. Twelve simultaneous 16,384-credit reservations exceed its old 100,000 budget. The fixture now has a bounded 1,000,000 budget, keeps every functional/cohort assertion, records useful failing CPU/slot information and passes thirty repetitions. Production instruction-budget accounting is unchanged.

A test-construction seccomp ALLOW instruction initially omitted one byte. It was corrected before baseline/final source checks. The production accepted-policy path is unchanged apart from admitting syscall 169.
Final changed Rust hashes match Linux CI and the paired Mac runtime. Mac development gates 1-8 of 12 pass; stable packaging and physical iPad installation are outside this round.
